gloss_en: How do I generate an IfcRoad with IfcOpenShell? Wants a code snippet like the IfcWall example, e.g. a straight road from two points.
title_original: How can I generate an IFCRoad using IfcOpenShell ?
question_paraphrase: is there any example that explains how to generate an IFCRoad via IFCOpenShell? looking for a snippet with two points, a straight line, like the IfcWall example
phrasing_notes: short, no greeting, compares to wall example
answer_summary: IfcRoad is created like any entity (createIfcRoad / root.create_entity); the real need is alignment-based geometry.

gloss_en: Infra model exported as IFC4 has everything as IfcBuildingElementProxy; wants to upgrade to IFC4.3 to reassign to IfcRoad classes, but the upgrade throws a Python error.
title_original: Upgrading IFC4 into IFC4.3 file using Blender to use IfcRoad and related classes
question_paraphrase: how can I introduce IfcRoad and related classes instead of painful BuildingElementProxy to my IFC model? upgrade gives a python error
answer_summary: Use the IFC4X3 upgrade option in the open dialog, then reassign classes; the error needs a matching IfcOpenShell build.

gloss_en: The buildingSMART sample with a signal placed by IfcLinearPlacement appears at the origin when loaded in Blender; transformation matrix looks flipped.
title_original: IfcLinearPlacement of signal shows signal at origin
question_paraphrase: signal with IfcLinearPlacement shows at origin, is the 4x4 matrix transposed? sample from the IFC4.3.x sample models
answer_summary: Matrix layout/transposition and linear placement not yet applied in the Blender importer.

gloss_en: Opening an IFC4x3 file with ifcopenshell python raises Unsupported schema IFC4X3.
title_original: ifcopenshell.SchemaError: Unsupported schema: IFC4X3
question_paraphrase: i am trying to open a IFC4x3 file with ifcopenshell python but i get the error that IFC4x3 is not supported
answer_summary: Schema identifier must be IFC4X3_ADD2 and the build must include that schema; conda package differences matter.

gloss_en: Parsing alignment geometry from the rail sample UT_AWC_1 fails: IfcGradientCurve / IfcCurveSegment not implemented.

answer_summary: Maintainers list the work: spirals, horizontal+vertical (gradient curve), cant (segmented reference curve), sweeps.

answer_summary: Community volunteers offered to mentor; infra authoring API work planned.

gloss_en: Trying to add IfcRail and IfcRailwayPart facilities from a Spanish rail classification sample, but entities show up as IfcSpace.

context_given: sample from SCF rail classification system
answer_summary: Bonsai did not allow nested IfcRailwayPart; only IfcSpace could be added inside.

gloss_en: README says IFC4x3 release candidates are supported, but schema_by_name('IFC4x3') raises No schema named.

question_paraphrase: so i wanted to test it with a simple example: schema_by_name IFC4x3 throws No schema named IFC4x3
answer_summary: Identifier is case sensitive (IFC4X3); bundled build lacked it, conda-forge package works.

gloss_en: Converting an IfcFixedReferenceSweptAreaSolid swept along an IfcGradientCurve to glTF gives wrong geometry although DESITE/BIMcollab show it correctly.

question_paraphrase: IFC to gltf of IfcFixedReferenceSweptAreaSolid with IfcGradientCurve directrix gives unexpected geometry, fine in DESITE or BIMcollab
answer_summary: Viewers (ODA, RDF) disagree on steep gradients/jumps; schema ADD2 and IfcLengthMeasure fixes tried.

gloss_en: A viaduct IFC4.3 ADD2 file does not render in BlenderBIM with IfcOpenShell 0.8.0 and throws a collection KeyError.

question_paraphrase: default settings don't render a thing, error KeyError on parent GlobalId collection
phrasing_notes: informal, attaches zip, tried many settings
answer_summary: Aggregate collection error and linear placement not implemented in that build; IfcConvert to dae worked.

gloss_en: How to get the object placement as a 4x4 matrix from Python for grid and linear placements, not only local placement.

answer_summary: Currently only by instantiating a product; v0.8 better.

gloss_en: Railway alignment with cant: sectioned surface twist from cant is ignored in the loft.

question_paraphrase: the twist due to cant is not being properly considered when making the loft for the IfcSectionedSurface
answer_summary: Use curve normal/tangent when Axis and RefDirection are omitted.

answer_summary: Dropping was intentional: the spec is unclear on how to model such referents.
